question: The Asian Games Federation was inaugurated in New Delhi in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Asian Games Federation** was inaugurated in **New Delhi**, India, in the year **1951**.
 
• The first **Asian Games**, also known as the **Asiad**, were held in **New Delhi** from **4th March to 11th March 1951**.
 
• This event marked the beginning of the **Asian Games movement**, with the aim of fostering goodwill and understanding among Asian nations.
 
• Eleven nations participated in the **1951 Asian Games**, and six sports were featured, including **athletics, aquatics, basketball, cycling, football, and weightlifting**.
 
• The idea of the Asian Games was first proposed by **Guru Dutt Sondhi**, an Indian sports administrator, during the **1947 Asian Relations Conference**.
